blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Identify the four ISO/US air classification levels and their corresponding particle and microbiological action levels — 識別四種ISO/美國潔淨室分級及其對應的微粒與微生物行動水準
blocks.en: Identify the four ISO/US air classification levels and their corresponding particle and microbiological action levels

blocks.zh: Explain the purpose and requirements of Critical Area (Class 100 / ISO 5) — 說明關鍵區域（Class 100 / ISO 5）的用途與要求
blocks.en: Explain the purpose and requirements of the Critical Area (Class 100 / ISO 5)

blocks.zh: Describe positive pressure differential requirements between adjacent cleanroom zones — 描述相鄰潔淨室區域之間的正壓差要求
blocks.en: Describe positive pressure differential requirements between adjacent cleanroom zones

blocks.zh: Understand HEPA filter leak testing criteria and frequency — 瞭解HEPA過濾器洩漏測試標準與頻率
blocks.en: Understand HEPA filter leak testing criteria and frequency

blocks.zh: Apply facility design principles to minimize aseptic intervention risk — 應用廠房設計原則以降低無菌操作介入風險
blocks.en: Apply facility design principles to minimize aseptic intervention risk

blocks.zh: Recognize CDMO capital and operational cost implications of cleanroom classification decisions — 認識潔淨室分級決策對CDMO資本與運營成本的影響
blocks.en: Recognize the capital and operating cost implications of cleanroom classification decisions for a CDMO

blocks.zh: Overview & Regulatory Citations / 概述與法規引用
blocks.en: Overview & Regulatory Citations

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — 概述與法規引用
blocks.en: Guide - Overview and Regulatory Citations

blocks.zh: 無菌製造廠房的設計不是一刀切的。FDA要求不同操作區域達到不同等級的空氣品質，這取決於該區域內所暴露的設備、原料、產品，以及所進行的操作活動。
blocks.en: The design of an aseptic manufacturing facility is not one-size-fits-all. FDA expects different areas to meet different levels of air quality, depending on the equipment, materials and product exposed in the area and the activities performed there.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：法規框架
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 本節涉及的CFR條文分為三個層次：
blocks.en: The CFR provisions covered in this section fall into four layers:

blocks.zh: 廠房設計層：211.42(b)/(c)(10) — 佈局流向、無菌區硬體要求
blocks.en: Facility design layer: 211.42(b)/(c)(10) - layout and flow, hardware requirements for aseptic areas

blocks.zh: 空調與過濾層：211.46(b)/(c) — 壓力、溫濕度、過濾系統
blocks.en: HVAC and filtration layer: 211.46(b)/(c) - pressure, temperature and humidity, filtration systems

blocks.zh: 設備與維護層：211.63、211.65(a)、211.67(a) — 設計、材質、清潔
blocks.en: Equipment and maintenance layer: 211.63, 211.65(a), 211.67(a) - design, materials, cleaning

blocks.zh: 程序與驗證層：211.113(b) — 微生物污染預防SOP及滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Procedures and validation layer: 211.113(b) - procedures for preventing microbiological contamination, and sterilization validation

blocks.zh: 理解各條文的適用範圍，是回答FDA 483觀察報告時的第一步。
blocks.en: Understanding the scope of each provision is the first step in responding to an FDA Form 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：廚房安全分區
blocks.en: Analogy: Kitchen Safety Zones

blocks.zh: 想像一家米其林餐廳的廚房分區：擺盤出餐區（類似Class 100，不容任何污染）、主廚備料區（Class 10,000）、洗碗區（Class 100,000）。每個區域的清潔要求、人員進入規定，以及空氣流向，都從「最乾淨」往「較不乾淨」方向設計，確保污染不會「逆流」。
blocks.en: Picture the kitchen of a Michelin-starred restaurant: the plating and pass area (like Class 100, no contamination tolerated), the chef's prep area (Class 10,000) and the dishwashing area (Class 100,000). The cleanliness requirements, personnel entry rules and airflow in each zone are all designed to run from "cleanest" to "less clean", so contamination never "flows backward".

blocks.zh: CDMO商業視角
blocks.en: CDMO Commercial Perspective

blocks.zh: 這些CFR引用條文不只是合規要求，更直接影響廠房建設成本。211.42(c)(10)列出的六項硬體要求（光滑表面、溫濕控制、HEPA正壓、環境監測、清潔消毒系統、設備維護系統），每一項都代表可觀的資本支出（CapEx）。CDMO在報價給客戶時，廠房等級越高，攤銷到每批產品的成本越高。
blocks.en: These CFR citations are not only compliance requirements; they directly drive facility construction cost. The six hardware requirements listed in 211.42(c)(10) (smooth surfaces, temperature and humidity control, HEPA-filtered air under positive pressure, environmental monitoring, cleaning and disinfection systems, equipment maintenance systems) each represent substantial capital expenditure (CapEx). When a CDMO quotes a client, the higher the facility classification, the higher the cost amortized into each batch.

blocks.zh: 快速自我測驗
blocks.en: Quick Self-Check

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.42(c)(10) 要求無菌區必須具備哪六項設施條件？
blocks.en: What six facility conditions does 21 CFR 211.42(c)(10) require for aseptic areas?

blocks.zh: 211.113(b) 中提到的「驗證」是指什麼類型的驗證？
blocks.en: What type of validation is referred to in 211.113(b)?

blocks.zh: 211.65(a) 中「不得具吸附性」對設備選材有何實務影響？
blocks.en: In 211.65(a), what is the practical effect of "shall not be absorptive" on equipment material selection?

blocks.zh: Table 1 — Air Classifications / 空氣潔淨度分級表
blocks.en: Table 1 - Air Classifications

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — Table 1 空氣分級詳解
blocks.en: Guide - Table 1 Air Classifications in Detail

blocks.zh: Table 1是本節的核心參考表，涵蓋粒子計數與微生物行動水準兩個維度，所有監控程序（環境監測、媒體灌裝合格標準）均以此表為依據。
blocks.en: Table 1 is the core reference table of this section. It covers two dimensions, particle counts and microbiological action levels, and all monitoring programs (environmental monitoring, media fill acceptance criteria) are based on it.

blocks.zh: 如何閱讀這張表
blocks.en: How to Read the Table

blocks.zh: US分級（Class 100/1,000/10,000/100,000）是舊制，FDA指引仍沿用
blocks.en: US classes (Class 100/1,000/10,000/100,000) are the older system, which FDA guidance still uses

blocks.zh: ISO分級（ISO 5~8）是國際標準，與US分級一一對應
blocks.en: ISO classes (ISO 5 to 8) are the international standard and correspond one-to-one with the US classes

blocks.zh: 粒子標準：以≥0.5 µm的粒子數量定義，單位是particles/m³
blocks.en: Particle limits: defined by the number of particles ≥0.5 µm, in particles/m³

blocks.zh: 微生物標準：分為主動空氣採樣（cfu/m³）與沉降碟（cfu/4小時）
blocks.en: Microbiological limits: split into active air sampling (cfu/m³) and settling plates (cfu/4 hours)

blocks.zh: ISO 5（Class 100）的微生物行動水準為「1 cfu/m³」，實務上要求「正常情況下不得偵測到微生物」
blocks.en: The microbiological action level for ISO 5 (Class 100) is "1 cfu/m³", but in practice the expectation is that "no microorganisms should normally be detected"

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院不同區域的清潔分級
blocks.en: Analogy: Cleanliness Grades in a Hospital

blocks.zh: 可以用醫院來理解這四個等級：
blocks.en: A hospital helps explain the four classes:

blocks.zh: Class 100（ISO 5）= 手術室：最嚴格，外科器械直接接觸病人，任何污染都可能致命
blocks.en: Class 100 (ISO 5) = operating room: the strictest; surgical instruments contact the patient directly, and any contamination can be fatal

blocks.zh: Class 1,000（ISO 6）= 開刀房外走廊：緊鄰手術室，人員進出受管控
blocks.en: Class 1,000 (ISO 6) = corridor outside the operating room: immediately adjacent to the operating room, with controlled personnel movement

blocks.zh: Class 10,000（ISO 7）= 病房走廊：有一定管制但允許更多人員流動
blocks.en: Class 10,000 (ISO 7) = ward corridor: some control, but more people movement is allowed

blocks.zh: Class 100,000（ISO 8）= 門診候診室：進行一般性活動，仍有基本管控
blocks.en: Class 100,000 (ISO 8) = outpatient waiting room: general activity, with basic controls still in place

blocks.zh: 就如同任何人不能穿著一般服裝直接走進手術室，無菌製造也用「等級分區」確保最關鍵的暴露區不受污染。
blocks.en: Just as nobody walks into an operating room in street clothes, aseptic manufacturing uses graded zones to keep the most critical exposed area free from contamination.

blocks.zh: 「行動水準」vs.「規格限」的重要區別
blocks.en: Key Difference: "Action Level" vs. "Specification Limit"

blocks.zh: Table 1 中的數值是行動水準（Action Levels），不是絕對的「合格/不合格」規格限。超過行動水準時，企業必須立即調查原因並採取糾正措施（CAPA），但不一定自動導致批次拒絕。然而，Class 100區域的微生物行動水準（1 cfu/m³）在實務上等同於「零容忍」。
blocks.en: The values in Table 1 are Action Levels, not absolute pass/fail specification limits. When an action level is exceeded, the firm must immediately investigate the cause and take corrective action (CAPA), but this does not automatically lead to batch rejection. However, the microbiological action level for the Class 100 area (1 cfu/m³) is in practice equivalent to "zero tolerance".

blocks.zh: 粒子數換算關係
blocks.en: Particle Count Relationships

blocks.zh: 每個分級的粒子數相差10倍，便於記憶：
blocks.en: The particle limit differs by a factor of 10 between each class, which makes it easy to remember:

blocks.zh: 在FDA查廠時，查驗員往往直接考核操作人員是否能背出本廠所用分級的粒子標準值。
blocks.en: During FDA inspections, investigators often test whether operators can recite the particle limits for the classes used in their own facility.

blocks.zh: CDMO成本角度：分級越高、投資越重
blocks.en: CDMO Cost Perspective: The Higher the Class, the Heavier the Investment

blocks.zh: Class 100（ISO 5）潔淨室的建置成本可能是Class 100,000（ISO 8）的5~10倍以上，主要因為需要更高密度的HEPA過濾、更精密的氣流設計（單向流）、更嚴格的環境監測基礎設施，以及更高頻率的驗證活動。CDMO在設計廠房時，必須評估各分級區的實際使用面積，避免「過度分類」造成不必要的運營成本。
blocks.en: Building a Class 100 (ISO 5) cleanroom can cost 5 to 10 times more than a Class 100,000 (ISO 8) one, mainly because it needs denser HEPA coverage, more sophisticated airflow design (unidirectional flow), more rigorous environmental monitoring infrastructure and more frequent validation activities. When designing a facility, a CDMO must assess the actual floor area needed at each classification and avoid "over-classification", which creates unnecessary operating cost.

blocks.zh: Table 1 應用練習
blocks.en: Table 1 Practice Questions

blocks.zh: ISO 7對應的美國分級是哪一個？其粒子標準（particles/m³）為何？
blocks.en: Which US class corresponds to ISO 7, and what is its particle limit (particles/m³)?

blocks.zh: 若沉降碟（90mm）在4小時內偵測到6 cfu，該區域應達到什麼分級以上才能接受？
blocks.en: If a settling plate (90 mm) detects 6 cfu in 4 hours, what is the minimum classification at which that area would be acceptable?

blocks.zh: Class 100區域的主動空氣採樣行動水準為何？若超過此值應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: What is the active air sampling action level for a Class 100 area, and what should be done if it is exceeded?

blocks.zh: EU Grade A與Table 1哪個分級最接近？有無重要差異？
blocks.en: Which EU grade is closest to Table 1 classes? Are there important differences?

blocks.zh: IV.A — Critical Area: Class 100 (ISO 5) / 關鍵區域
blocks.en: IV.A - Critical Area: Class 100 (ISO 5)

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — 關鍵區域（Class 100 / ISO 5）
blocks.en: Guide - Critical Area (Class 100 / ISO 5)

blocks.zh: Critical Area是整個無菌製造廠房中最重要的區域——藥品、容器、密封件在此暴露，且後續不會再次滅菌。一旦此處受到污染，批次就必須拒絕。FDA在查廠時，對關鍵區域的審查最為嚴格。
blocks.en: The Critical Area is the most important area in the whole aseptic manufacturing facility. Drug product, containers and closures are exposed here and are not sterilized again afterward. If contamination occurs here, the batch must be rejected. FDA scrutinizes the critical area most closely during inspections.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區域的三個核心要求
blocks.en: Three Core Requirements for the Critical Area

blocks.zh: 粒子要求：≥0.5 µm 粒子不超過 3,520 /m³，等同ISO 5標準，量測位置距離工作點不超過1英尺
blocks.en: Particles: no more than 3,520 particles/m³ at ≥0.5 µm, equivalent to ISO 5, measured within 1 foot of the work site

blocks.zh: 微生物要求：正常情況下不得偵測到微生物（行動水準 1 cfu/m³，但實務目標為零）
blocks.en: Microorganisms: none should normally be detected (action level 1 cfu/m³, but the practical target is zero)

blocks.zh: 氣流要求：單向流（Unidirectional Flow），流速 0.45 m/s（90 ft/min）±20%
blocks.en: Airflow: unidirectional flow, with air velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 ft/min) ±20%

blocks.zh: 比喻：無塵工廠的精密晶片生產
blocks.en: Analogy: Precision Chip Production in a Clean Factory

blocks.zh: Class 100潔淨區就像半導體廠的晶片曝光室——晶圓在此被刻印電路，任何一粒灰塵都可能毀掉整片晶圓。廠商投入數億元打造超潔淨環境，且操作人員在進入前必須完整更衣。同理，無菌填充區投入的工程成本，正是為了保護那瓶無法「重來」的藥品。
blocks.en: A Class 100 clean area is like the exposure room of a semiconductor fab: circuits are imprinted on the wafer there, and a single dust particle can ruin the whole wafer. Manufacturers invest enormous sums in an ultra-clean environment, and operators must fully gown before entering. Likewise, the engineering investment in an aseptic filling area exists to protect that one vial of drug product that cannot be "redone".

blocks.zh: 單向流（Unidirectional Flow）的物理原理
blocks.en: The Physics of Unidirectional Flow

blocks.zh: HEPA過濾後的空氣以均勻速度（0.45 m/s）向下「掃除」粒子，形成一道「空氣簾」保護暴露的藥品。關鍵點：
blocks.en: HEPA-filtered air "sweeps" particles downward at a uniform velocity (0.45 m/s), forming an "air curtain" that protects the exposed product. Key points:

blocks.zh: 速度太低（<0.36 m/s）→ 無法有效掃除，粒子可能滯留
blocks.en: Velocity too low (<0.36 m/s): particles are not swept away effectively and may linger

blocks.zh: 速度太高（>0.54 m/s）→ 氣流擾動過大，反而可能產生渦流
blocks.en: Velocity too high (>0.54 m/s): excessive turbulence may actually create eddies

blocks.zh: 煙霧試驗（Smoke Study）在動態條件下執行，確認沒有「死角」或渦流
blocks.en: Smoke studies are performed under dynamic conditions to confirm there are no "dead spots" or eddies

blocks.zh: 遠端計數系統 vs. 手持式計數器
blocks.en: Remote Counting Systems vs. Handheld Counters

blocks.zh: FDA明確推薦使用遠端採樣系統（Remote Counting System），原因是：手持式計數器需要操作人員靠近工作區，操作員本身就是粒子和微生物的來源，會干擾量測結果的代表性。遠端系統可在操作員不在場的情況下持續監測，數據更客觀、更全面。
blocks.en: FDA explicitly recommends a remote sampling system (remote counting system). A handheld counter requires the operator to stand close to the work area, and the operator is themselves a source of particles and microorganisms, which compromises how representative the measurement is. A remote system can monitor continuously without the operator present, giving more objective and more complete data.

blocks.zh: 粉末灌裝（如凍乾粉針）產生的「產品本身粒子」不代表污染風險，可設計分開的採樣策略來區分外源性粒子。
blocks.en: Particles generated by the product itself during powder filling (such as lyophilized powder for injection) do not represent a contamination risk; a separate sampling strategy can be designed to distinguish extrinsic particles.

blocks.zh: 查廠焦點：Smoke Study的常見缺失
blocks.en: Inspection Focus: Common Smoke Study Deficiencies

blocks.zh: FDA 483觀察報告中，Smoke Study（氣流可視化研究）的常見缺失包括：只在靜態（無人員）條件下執行、未覆蓋所有填充位置、影像記錄不完整或解析度不足。建議在驗證計畫中明確定義動態條件的定義（人員數量、設備狀態、模擬操作內容）。
blocks.en: Common smoke study (airflow visualization) deficiencies cited in FDA Form 483 observations include: performing the study only under static (no personnel) conditions, not covering all filling positions, and incomplete or low-resolution video records. Define dynamic conditions explicitly in the validation plan (number of personnel, equipment status, simulated operations).

blocks.zh: 關鍵區域核心練習
blocks.en: Critical Area Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼關鍵區域的污染「不可逆」？這與最終滅菌產品（Terminal Sterilization）有何根本差異？
blocks.en: Why is contamination in the critical area "irreversible"? How does this fundamentally differ from terminally sterilized products?

blocks.zh: 建議的HEPA氣流速度為0.45 m/s ±20%，計算可接受的最低與最高速度值（m/s）。
blocks.en: The recommended HEPA air velocity is 0.45 m/s ±20%. Calculate the minimum and maximum acceptable velocities (m/s).

blocks.zh: 進行Smoke Study時，為何必須在「動態條件」下執行？靜態條件的結果有何局限？
blocks.en: Why must a smoke study be performed under "dynamic conditions"? What are the limitations of results obtained under static conditions?

blocks.zh: 填充操作中偵測到粒子數偏高，操作人員聲稱是「粉末產品本身的粒子」。你如何驗證此說法？
blocks.en: During filling, a high particle count is detected and the operator claims it is "particles from the powder product itself". How would you verify this claim?

blocks.zh: IV.B — Supporting Clean Areas / 支撐潔淨區
blocks.en: IV.B - Supporting Clean Areas

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — 支撐潔淨區
blocks.en: Guide - Supporting Clean Areas

blocks.zh: 無菌製造廠房不只有一個「最乾淨」的核心區，圍繞在核心區周圍的「支撐區」同樣需要依照風險程度進行分級管理。支撐區的主要功能是為關鍵區提供已清潔、已準備好的物料與設備。
blocks.en: An aseptic manufacturing facility does not have just one "cleanest" core area. The "supporting areas" surrounding the core also need risk-based classification. Their main function is to supply the critical area with cleaned and prepared materials and equipment.

blocks.zh: 支撐區分級邏輯
blocks.en: Classification Logic for Supporting Areas

blocks.zh: FDA的分級建議具有彈性，企業可以選擇更嚴格的標準：
blocks.en: FDA's classification recommendations are flexible, and firms may choose stricter standards:

blocks.zh: 最低要求：緊鄰無菌填充線的區域，至少Class 10,000（ISO 7）
blocks.en: Minimum requirement: the area immediately adjacent to the aseptic filling line should be at least Class 10,000 (ISO 7)

blocks.zh: 升級選項A：緊鄰區升級為Class 1,000（ISO 6）
blocks.en: Upgrade option A: upgrade the adjacent area to Class 1,000 (ISO 6)

blocks.zh: 升級選項B：整個無菌填充室維持Class 100（ISO 5）
blocks.en: Upgrade option B: maintain the entire aseptic filling room at Class 100 (ISO 5)

blocks.zh: 較低分級區：設備清洗等活動，Class 100,000（ISO 8）即可
blocks.en: Lower-classification areas: activities such as equipment washing can be performed in Class 100,000 (ISO 8)

blocks.zh: 選擇升級選項可降低操作風險，但需要更高的建設與運營成本。
blocks.en: Choosing an upgrade option can reduce operational risk but requires higher construction and operating costs.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術室的緩衝走廊
blocks.en: Analogy: The Buffer Corridor of an Operating Room

blocks.zh: 手術室（Class 100）的外面通常有一條「潔淨走廊」（Class 10,000），再外面才是「半清潔走廊」（Class 100,000）。這種設計讓污染從外到內逐步被過濾與阻擋，而非直接從外部環境進入手術室。無菌製造廠房的「支撐潔淨區」設計理念完全相同。
blocks.en: Outside an operating room (Class 100) there is usually a "clean corridor" (Class 10,000), and beyond that a "semi-clean corridor" (Class 100,000). This design filters and blocks contamination step by step from the outside in, rather than letting it enter the operating room directly from the external environment. The "supporting clean area" concept in an aseptic facility is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 分級決策的風險驅動原則
blocks.en: The Risk-Driven Principle of Classification

blocks.zh: 每個房間的分級必須反映其中風險最高的活動。如果一個Class 100,000的清洗間偶爾被用來暫存已滅菌但未密封的容器，那麼這個房間就需要重新評估其分級。FDA查廠時會核對房間用途與實際監測數據的一致性。
blocks.en: The classification of each room must reflect the highest-risk activity performed in it. If a Class 100,000 washing room is occasionally used to hold sterilized but unsealed containers, the classification of that room must be re-evaluated. During inspections FDA checks that the use of each room is consistent with its actual monitoring data.

blocks.zh: CDMO廠房規劃考量
blocks.en: CDMO Facility Planning Considerations

blocks.zh: 對CDMO而言，支撐區的分級選擇直接影響廠房設計的彈性：整個填充室維持Class 100（選項B）可以簡化操作程序，但建設成本大幅提高；最低要求（ISO 7緊鄰區）雖然節省成本，但需要更嚴格的物料進出管制程序。多產品共用廠房（Multi-product Facility）的分級設計尤為複雜，必須考慮最嚴格產品的需求。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the classification of supporting areas directly affects design flexibility: keeping the whole filling room at Class 100 (option B) simplifies operating procedures but greatly increases construction cost; the minimum requirement (ISO 7 adjacent area) saves cost but requires stricter material and personnel flow controls. Classification design for a multi-product facility is especially complex, as it must meet the needs of the most demanding product.

blocks.zh: 支撐區練習
blocks.en: Supporting Area Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個用來清洗設備零件的房間，FDA建議的最低分級為何？
blocks.en: For a room used to wash equipment parts, what is the minimum classification FDA recommends?

blocks.zh: 如果填充室緊鄰區被升級至ISO 5，對環境監測計畫有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the area adjacent to the filling room is upgraded to ISO 5, how does this affect the environmental monitoring program?

blocks.zh: 「活動驅動分級（activity-driven classification）」是什麼意思？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: What does "activity-driven classification" mean? Give an example.

blocks.zh: IV.C — Clean Area Separation / 潔淨區隔離
blocks.en: IV.C - Clean Area Separation

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — 潔淨區隔離與壓差管理
blocks.en: Guide - Clean Area Separation and Pressure Differential Management

blocks.zh: 壓差管理是無菌廠房防污染的「第一道防線」。只要不同分級的區域之間維持正確的壓差梯度，空氣就會自然從「乾淨」流向「較不乾淨」，而不是反向。
blocks.en: Pressure differential management is the "first line of defense" against contamination in an aseptic facility. As long as the correct pressure cascade is maintained between areas of different classification, air naturally flows from "clean" to "less clean" and not the reverse.

blocks.zh: 壓差要求的三個層次
blocks.en: Three Levels of Pressure Differential Requirements

blocks.zh: 相鄰不同分級房間：至少 10–15 Pa（門關閉狀態）
blocks.en: Adjacent rooms of different classification: at least 10-15 Pa (doors closed)

blocks.zh: 無菌處理室 vs. 非分級區域：至少 12.5 Pa 正壓（任何時候）
blocks.en: Aseptic processing room vs. unclassified area: at least 12.5 Pa positive pressure (at all times)

blocks.zh: 開門時：向外氣流應能有效阻擋低品質空氣流入，必須嚴格控制開門時間
blocks.en: When a door is open: outward airflow should effectively prevent lower-quality air from flowing in, and door-open time must be strictly controlled

blocks.zh: 壓差一旦低於最低值，必須先恢復並確認環境品質後才能繼續生產——這是強制要求，不是建議。
blocks.en: If the pressure differential falls below the minimum, it must be restored and the environmental quality confirmed before production can continue. This is a mandatory requirement, not a recommendation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機客艙的氣壓艙原理
blocks.en: Analogy: Aircraft Cabin Pressurization

blocks.zh: 飛機的機艙維持正壓（相對於外部大氣）防止外部冷空氣入侵；高鐵的月台門系統同樣利用壓差防止隧道風直接衝擊候車月台。無菌廠房的正壓差設計邏輯相同：潔淨室相對於走廊維持正壓，即使門縫有微小洩漏，氣流也是「向外推」，而非「向內吸」污染空氣。10–15 Pa 的壓差看起來微小，卻足以在門縫處形成穩定的「空氣牆」。
blocks.en: An aircraft cabin is kept at positive pressure (relative to the outside atmosphere) to keep cold outside air out; high-speed rail platform screen doors likewise use pressure difference to stop tunnel wind from blasting onto the waiting platform. The logic of positive pressure in an aseptic facility is the same: the cleanroom is held at positive pressure relative to the corridor, so even if there is a tiny leak at a door gap, the air is "pushed outward" rather than "sucking in" contaminated air. A differential of 10-15 Pa looks small, but it is enough to form a stable "air wall" at the door gap.

blocks.zh: FDA查廠重點：壓差記錄的連續性
blocks.en: Inspection Focus: Continuity of Pressure Differential Records

blocks.zh: FDA查驗員在查廠時，必定會要求調閱壓差監測記錄（Pressure Differential Logs），包括：
blocks.en: During an inspection, FDA investigators will certainly request the pressure differential monitoring records (Pressure Differential Logs), including:

blocks.zh: 每班次的連續記錄圖表（不只是每小時一筆點位數據）
blocks.en: Continuous recording charts for each shift (not just one point reading per hour)

blocks.zh: 所有警報（Alarm）記錄及其調查報告
blocks.en: All alarm records and their investigation reports

blocks.zh: 壓差偏低事件的影響評估（對相關批次的影響）
blocks.en: Impact assessments for low-pressure events (effect on the batches concerned)

blocks.zh: 警報記錄不完整或偏差未調查，是最常見的483觀察報告項目之一。
blocks.en: Incomplete alarm records or uninvestigated deviations are among the most common Form 483 observations.

blocks.zh: 換氣次數（Air Change Rate）快速參考
blocks.en: Air Change Rate Quick Reference

blocks.zh: Class 100,000（ISO 8）最低要求：20 ACH（Air Changes per Hour）
blocks.en: Class 100,000 (ISO 8) minimum requirement: 20 ACH (Air Changes per Hour)

blocks.zh: ACH = 每小時總送風量（m³/hr）÷ 房間體積（m³）
blocks.en: ACH = total supply airflow per hour (m³/hr) ÷ room volume (m³)

blocks.zh: Class 10,000（ISO 7）和Class 100（ISO 5）需要更高的換氣次數，具體值由驗證決定，通常ISO 7 ≥ 40–60 ACH，ISO 5層流工作站則由設計速度（0.45 m/s）決定，而非ACH。
blocks.en: Class 10,000 (ISO 7) and Class 100 (ISO 5) need higher air change rates, with specific values determined by validation, typically ≥ 40-60 ACH for ISO 7; for an ISO 5 laminar flow workstation, the design velocity (0.45 m/s) governs rather than ACH.

blocks.zh: CDMO運營視角：壓差監控系統選擇
blocks.en: CDMO Operations Perspective: Choosing a Pressure Differential Monitoring System

blocks.zh: 連續壓差監測需要安裝差壓傳感器（Differential Pressure Transducers）並整合至樓宇管理系統（BMS）或環境監測系統（EMS）。傳感器的維護（校驗週期）和警報閾值設定直接影響合規性。部分CDMO會選擇與FDA 21 CFR Part 11合規的EMS，確保所有數據都有電子稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）。
blocks.en: Continuous pressure differential monitoring requires differential pressure transducers integrated into a building management system (BMS) or environmental monitoring system (EMS). Sensor maintenance (calibration intervals) and alarm threshold settings directly affect compliance. Some CDMOs choose an EMS that complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 so that all data carry an electronic audit trail.

blocks.zh: 壓差管理練習
blocks.en: Pressure Differential Management Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 無菌填充室與相鄰更衣室之間的最低壓差要求是多少 Pa？
blocks.en: What is the minimum pressure differential (in Pa) between an aseptic filling room and the adjacent gowning room?

blocks.zh: 如果在填充過程中壓差突然降至5 Pa，操作人員應立即採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: If the pressure differential suddenly drops to 5 Pa during filling, what steps should operators take immediately?

blocks.zh: 一個Class 100,000的清洗室，最低換氣次數要求是多少 ACH？
blocks.en: For a Class 100,000 washing room, what is the minimum air change rate in ACH?

blocks.zh: 「連續監測」與「每小時記錄一次」在法規合規性上有何差異？
blocks.en: What is the difference in regulatory compliance between "continuous monitoring" and "recording once per hour"?

blocks.zh: IV.D — Air Filtration / 空氣過濾
blocks.en: IV.D - Air Filtration

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — 空氣過濾（膜過濾器與HEPA）
blocks.en: Guide - Air Filtration (Membrane Filters and HEPA)

blocks.zh: 空氣過濾是無菌製造的技術骨幹。本節涵蓋兩類過濾系統：用於壓縮氣體的膜過濾器，以及用於潔淨室空調的HEPA過濾器。兩者都有嚴格的完整性測試要求。
blocks.en: Air filtration is the technical backbone of aseptic manufacturing. This section covers two types of filtration systems: membrane filters for compressed gases, and HEPA filters for cleanroom air handling. Both have strict integrity testing requirements.

blocks.zh: D.1 膜過濾器：壓縮氣體的「看不見的污染源」
blocks.en: D.1 Membrane Filters: The "Invisible Source of Contamination" in Compressed Gases

blocks.zh: 壓縮氣體（氮氣、CO₂、壓縮空氣）廣泛用於推送物料、覆蓋保護藥品，但如果氣體本身含有粒子、油霧或微生物，就直接把污染「注入」產品中。
blocks.en: Compressed gases (nitrogen, CO₂, compressed air) are widely used to move materials and to blanket and protect drug product, but if the gas itself carries particles, oil mist or microorganisms, contamination is "injected" straight into the product.

blocks.zh: 膜過濾後的氣體品質必須≥所在潔淨室的等級
blocks.en: Gas quality after membrane filtration must be ≥ the classification of the cleanroom served

blocks.zh: 疏水性過濾器（Hydrophobic Filters）防止水氣——因為濕濾膜是微生物生長的溫床
blocks.en: Hydrophobic filters prevent moisture, because a wet membrane is a breeding ground for microorganisms

blocks.zh: 高壓釜（Autoclave）進氣管線、凍乾機（Lyophilizer）破真空管線，也都必須安裝膜過濾器
blocks.en: Autoclave inlet lines and lyophilizer vacuum-break lines must also be fitted with membrane filters

blocks.zh: 比喻：潛水氣瓶的氣體純度要求
blocks.en: Analogy: Purity Requirements for Scuba Tank Air

blocks.zh: 潛水員使用的壓縮空氣氣瓶，必須確保氣體中沒有油霧（油霧在高壓下會引起中毒）。製藥廠的壓縮氣體要求完全類似——吹入藥品容器的氮氣，必須像「手術室空氣」一樣潔淨。任何油分、水分、或微生物都可能成為污染媒介。
blocks.en: Compressed air in a diver's tank must contain no oil mist (oil mist at high pressure can cause poisoning). Compressed gases in a pharmaceutical plant face exactly the same requirement: nitrogen blown into drug containers must be as clean as "operating room air". Any oil, moisture or microorganisms can become a vehicle for contamination.

blocks.zh: D.2 HEPA過濾器：效率測試 vs. 洩漏測試
blocks.en: D.2 HEPA Filters: Efficiency Test vs. Leak Test

blocks.zh: 很多人混淆這兩種測試，但它們的目的完全不同：
blocks.en: Many people confuse these two tests, but their purposes are entirely different:

blocks.zh: 效率測試（Efficiency Test）
blocks.en: Efficiency Test

blocks.zh: 使用單分散0.3 µm粒子
blocks.en: Uses monodisperse 0.3 µm particles

blocks.zh: 評估整片濾材的整體過濾效率
blocks.en: Evaluates the overall filtration efficiency of the whole filter medium

blocks.zh: 確認濾材達到HEPA規格（≥99.97% @ 0.3 µm）
blocks.en: Confirms that the medium meets the HEPA specification (≥99.97% at 0.3 µm)

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試（Leak Test）
blocks.en: Leak Test

blocks.zh: 使用多分散氣膠（DOP或PAO）
blocks.en: Uses a polydisperse aerosol (DOP or PAO)

blocks.zh: 用光度計（Photometer）探頭距濾面1英寸掃描全部表面及邊框
blocks.en: A photometer probe scans the entire filter face and frame at 1 inch from the surface

blocks.zh: 流量≥1 ft³/min
blocks.en: Flow rate ≥1 ft³/min

blocks.zh: 目的是找出濾材針孔或邊框密封洩漏點
blocks.en: The purpose is to find pinholes in the medium or leaks in the frame seal

blocks.zh: 比喻：橋樑安全檢測——HEPA 0.01%洩漏標準
blocks.en: Analogy: Bridge Inspection - the HEPA 0.01% Leak Standard

blocks.zh: 橋樑工程師不只測試鋼材整體強度（= 效率測試），還要逐英寸掃描焊接點和螺栓連接處（= 洩漏測試）。HEPA的0.01%上游濃度標準就像橋樑的「裂縫容忍極限」——任何單點讀數超過此值，整片濾材就必須維修或更換，而不是平均合格就繼續使用。這個標準非常嚴格：即使整體效率達到99.99%，一個局部洩漏點仍然是不可接受的。
blocks.en: A bridge engineer tests not only the overall strength of the steel (= efficiency test) but also scans every inch of the welds and bolted joints (= leak test). The HEPA limit of 0.01% of upstream concentration is like a bridge's "crack tolerance limit": if any single-point reading exceeds it, the filter must be repaired or replaced, rather than being kept in use because the average passes. The standard is very strict: even if overall efficiency reaches 99.99%, a localized leak is still unacceptable.

blocks.zh: HEPA測試頻率的觸發條件
blocks.en: Triggers for HEPA Testing Frequency

blocks.zh: 除了每年兩次的例行測試外，以下任何一個事件都是額外測試的觸發條件：
blocks.en: In addition to routine testing twice a year, any of the following events triggers additional testing:

blocks.zh: 環境監測數據不合格（粒子或微生物超標）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring failures (particle or microbial excursions)

blocks.zh: 廠房裝修或設備更動（可能震動損壞濾材或密封）
blocks.en: Facility renovation or equipment changes (vibration may damage the medium or seals)

blocks.zh: 媒體灌裝（APS / Media Fill）失敗調查
blocks.en: Media fill (APS) failure investigations

blocks.zh: 無菌性測試（Sterility Test）失敗調查
blocks.en: Sterility test failure investigations

blocks.zh: 注意：乾熱去熱原隧道（Depyrogenation Tunnel）的HEPA也需要定期洩漏測試！這一點常被忽略。
blocks.en: Note: HEPA filters in a dry heat depyrogenation tunnel also need periodic leak testing. This is often overlooked!

blocks.zh: 速度均勻性：洩漏測試的必要補充
blocks.en: Velocity Uniformity: A Necessary Complement to Leak Testing

blocks.zh: 通過洩漏測試的HEPA不代表氣流均勻。如果某些濾面區域的速度明顯偏低，就會形成「低流速死角」，粒子在此沉積而非被帶走。FDA明確要求速度量測應在距濾面6英寸處及工作面設定距離處進行，發現不均勻時必須更換HEPA。
blocks.en: A HEPA filter that passes the leak test does not necessarily deliver uniform airflow. If velocity in some areas of the filter face is markedly low, "low-velocity dead spots" form where particles settle instead of being carried away. FDA expects velocity measurements at 6 inches from the filter face and at a defined distance from the work surface, and the HEPA filter must be replaced if non-uniformity is found.

blocks.zh: 委外測試的責任歸屬
blocks.en: Responsibility for Outsourced Testing

blocks.zh: 許多CDMO或藥廠將HEPA洩漏測試委外給認證公司執行。FDA明確聲明：即使委外，藥廠仍然對測試結果完全負責。這意味著藥廠必須：審查委外廠商的SOP、確認其使用的氣膠符合規格、審核測試記錄原始數據，並保存完整的委外稽核記錄。
blocks.en: Many CDMOs and pharmaceutical plants outsource HEPA leak testing to certified contractors. FDA states explicitly that even when testing is outsourced, the firm remains fully responsible for the results. This means the firm must review the contractor's SOPs, confirm that the aerosol used meets specifications, review the raw data in the test records, and keep complete records of contractor audits.

blocks.zh: 空氣過濾綜合練習
blocks.en: Air Filtration Comprehensive Practice Questions

blocks.zh: HEPA洩漏測試的合格標準是什麼？（以上游濃度百分比表示）
blocks.en: What is the acceptance criterion for a HEPA leak test (expressed as a percentage of upstream concentration)?

blocks.zh: 為什麼要使用疏水性膜過濾器於壓縮氣體管線？水氣對過濾器有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why use hydrophobic membrane filters on compressed gas lines? How does moisture affect the filter?

blocks.zh: DOP（磷苯二甲酸二辛酯）和PAO（聚-α-烯烴）作為洩漏測試氣膠有什麼共同的必要條件？（提示：不得…）
blocks.en: What requirement do DOP (dioctyl phthalate) and PAO (polyalphaolefin) share as leak test aerosols? (Hint: must not ...)

blocks.zh: 效率測試使用0.3 µm的單分散粒子，而非0.5 µm，原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does the efficiency test use monodisperse 0.3 µm particles rather than 0.5 µm?

blocks.zh: 如果一間無菌填充室的HEPA通過了洩漏測試，但速度量測顯示某區域只有0.30 m/s（遠低於0.45 m/s的標準），FDA會要求什麼處置？
blocks.en: If the HEPA filters in an aseptic filling room pass the leak test but velocity measurements show only 0.30 m/s in one area (far below the 0.45 m/s standard), what action would FDA require?

blocks.zh: IV.E — Design / 廠房設計
blocks.en: IV.E - Design

blocks.zh: 中文導讀 — 廠房與設備設計
blocks.en: Guide - Facility and Equipment Design

blocks.zh: IV.E是全節中實務操作密度最高的部分。這裡的設計原則直接影響無菌操作的成功率、環境監測的結果，以及FDA查廠的合規評分。
blocks.en: IV.E is the most practically dense part of the whole section. The design principles here directly affect the success rate of aseptic operations, environmental monitoring results and FDA inspection outcomes.

blocks.zh: 設計哲學：「防禦性設計」
blocks.en: Design Philosophy: "Defensive Design"

blocks.zh: FDA的設計原則可以歸納為四個「最小化」：
blocks.en: FDA's design principles can be summarized as four "minimizes":

blocks.zh: 最小化暴露時間：無菌物品在開放環境中的時間越短越好
blocks.en: Minimize exposure time: the shorter sterile items spend in an open environment, the better

blocks.zh: 最小化人員介入：每一次人員介入都是污染機會
blocks.en: Minimize personnel intervention: every intervention is an opportunity for contamination

blocks.zh: 最小化低品質空氣侵入：設備設計不能阻礙單向流或造成渦流
blocks.en: Minimize ingress of lower-quality air: equipment design must not obstruct unidirectional flow or create turbulence

blocks.zh: 最小化不必要設施：多餘的架子、管線、設備都是積塵和清潔死角
blocks.en: Minimize unnecessary fixtures: superfluous shelves, piping and equipment collect dust and create cleaning dead spots

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫療手術室的「人員最小化」原則
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Minimal Personnel" Principle in Surgery

blocks.zh: 頂級外科手術室有一條不成文規定：「非必要人員不得入室」。每增加一個人，就增加一個產生微粒和微生物的來源。無菌製造室完全相同。FDA明確要求降低填充室的人員數量，並限制進出關鍵區的頻率。「人員即污染源」是無菌製造設計的核心認知。
blocks.en: Top operating rooms have an unwritten rule: "no non-essential personnel in the room". Each additional person adds a source of particles and microorganisms. An aseptic manufacturing room is no different. FDA explicitly expects fewer personnel in the filling room and limits on how often the critical area is entered. "People are the contamination source" is the core premise of aseptic design.

blocks.zh: 自動化與隔離技術的層次
blocks.en: Tiers of Automation and Isolation Technology

blocks.zh: FDA對減少人員介入的推薦技術，由低到高：
blocks.en: Technologies FDA recommends for reducing personnel intervention, from lower to higher level:

blocks.zh: 在線重量檢測：消除手動稱重介入（簡單但有效）
blocks.en: In-line weight checking: eliminates manual weighing interventions (simple but effective)

blocks.zh: SIP（原位滅菌）：消除無菌管路連接——連接點本身就是污染風險
blocks.en: SIP (steam-in-place / sterilize-in-place): eliminates aseptic piping connections, since the connection points themselves are a contamination risk

blocks.zh: 機器人/自動化：完全排除人員在關鍵區的操作（高投資，最高保護）
blocks.en: Robotics/automation: removes personnel from critical area operations entirely (high investment, highest protection)

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）：在物理隔離的正壓或負壓環境中操作，為最高等級的保護
blocks.en: Isolator: operation in a physically separated positive or negative pressure environment, offering the highest level of protection

blocks.zh: 凍乾製程（Lyophilization）的設計要求
blocks.en: Design Requirements for Lyophilization

blocks.zh: 半加塞的凍乾製品從灌裝線到凍乾機的轉移，是無菌製造中最高風險的步驟之一：
blocks.en: Transfer of partially stoppered lyophilized product from the filling line to the lyophilizer is one of the highest-risk steps in aseptic manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 轉移路徑全程必須維持Class 100（ISO 5）
blocks.en: The entire transfer path must be maintained at Class 100 (ISO 5)

blocks.zh: 若使用隔離器（Isolator）從灌裝線直接連接凍乾機，可大幅降低此風險
blocks.en: Connecting the filling line directly to the lyophilizer with an isolator greatly reduces this risk

blocks.zh: 壓克力簾或硬式隔板可作為局部保護屏障
blocks.en: Acrylic curtains or rigid partitions can serve as local protective barriers

blocks.zh: 完成軋蓋（Crimping）前，已加塞但未軋蓋的小瓶仍需局部保護
blocks.en: Until crimping is complete, stoppered but uncrimped vials still require local protection

blocks.zh: 潔淨室建設細節：為什麼角落必須弧形？
blocks.en: Cleanroom Construction Details: Why Must Corners Be Coved?

blocks.zh: 直角角落（90°）是微粒和微生物的藏身之處——傳統清潔方式無法徹底清潔直角接縫。FDA要求「地板與牆壁交接處採用弧形圓角（Coved Corners）」，目的是：
blocks.en: Right-angle (90°) corners harbor particles and microorganisms, and conventional cleaning cannot thoroughly clean a right-angle joint. FDA expects "coved corners where floors meet walls", in order to:

blocks.zh: 消除清潔死角，確保消毒液能完整覆蓋所有表面
blocks.en: Eliminate cleaning dead spots so that disinfectant fully covers all surfaces

blocks.zh: 減少微生物的物理庇護空間
blocks.en: Reduce physical refuge for microorganisms

blocks.zh: 便於目視檢查（沒有暗角積塵）
blocks.en: Allow easy visual inspection (no dark corners where dust collects)

blocks.zh: 同理，排水口（Drains）在ISO 5/6/7的潔淨室中是不被允許的，因為排水管是微生物的通道——只有ISO 8（Class 100,000）區域（如清洗間）才允許設置排水口。
blocks.en: Likewise, drains are not permitted in ISO 5/6/7 cleanrooms because drain pipes are a pathway for microorganisms; drains are allowed only in ISO 8 (Class 100,000) areas such as washing rooms.

blocks.zh: 停機後的恢復程序：常被忽略的合規要求
blocks.en: Recovery After Shutdown: A Frequently Overlooked Compliance Requirement

blocks.zh: 空調系統非計畫性停機（如電力故障）後，不能在恢復供電後立即重啟生產。必須有書面SOP規定：
blocks.en: After an unplanned HVAC shutdown (such as a power failure), production cannot restart immediately once power is restored. A written SOP must specify:

blocks.zh: 恢復空調後的「回沖（Purge）」時間
blocks.en: The "purge" time after HVAC is restored

blocks.zh: 必須執行的環境確認監測（粒子+微生物）
blocks.en: The environmental verification monitoring that must be performed (particles + microorganisms)

blocks.zh: 確認壓差已恢復至合格範圍
blocks.en: Confirmation that pressure differentials have returned to the acceptable range

blocks.zh: 記錄停機事件及恢復確認結果
blocks.en: Documentation of the shutdown event and the results of the recovery verification

blocks.zh: FDA在查廠時如果發現缺少此類書面程序，會直接開具483觀察報告。
blocks.en: If FDA finds no such written procedure during an inspection, it will issue a Form 483 observation directly.

blocks.zh: CDMO廠房設計的商業決策矩陣
blocks.en: Commercial Decision Matrix for CDMO Facility Design

blocks.zh: CDMO在為新客戶評估產品接受度時，廠房設計決策影響深遠：
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates whether it can accept a new client's product, facility design decisions have far-reaching effects:

blocks.zh: 隔離器 vs. 傳統RABS：隔離器初期成本高，但環境監測數據通常更好，有助於提高APS（無菌工藝模擬）合格率
blocks.en: Isolator vs. conventional RABS: an isolator has higher initial cost but usually yields better environmental monitoring data, which helps improve APS (aseptic process simulation) pass rates

blocks.zh: SIP管路設計：前期工程成本更高，但減少無菌連接程序，長期運營風險更低
blocks.en: SIP piping design: higher upfront engineering cost, but fewer aseptic connection procedures and lower long-term operating risk

blocks.zh: 機器人填充系統：高資本投入，但可承接高風險高價值產品（如細胞治療、基因治療），溢價收費
blocks.en: Robotic filling systems: high capital investment, but allow the CDMO to take on high-risk, high-value products (such as cell and gene therapies) at premium pricing

blocks.zh: 每一個設計升級都是「風險降低」與「成本增加」的平衡——CDMO的競爭力往往體現在這個取捨的智慧上。
blocks.en: Every design upgrade balances "risk reduction" against "cost increase"; a CDMO's competitiveness often lies in the judgment applied to these trade-offs.

blocks.zh: 設計原則綜合練習
blocks.en: Design Principles Comprehensive Practice Questions

blocks.zh: SIP（Sterilize-in-Place）如何減少無菌干預的次數？請描述傳統管路連接 vs. SIP的操作差異。
blocks.en: How does SIP (Sterilize-in-Place) reduce the number of aseptic interventions? Describe the operational difference between conventional piping connections and SIP.

blocks.zh: 為什麼ISO 5和ISO 7的潔淨室不得設置排水口（地漏）？ISO 8為何例外允許？
blocks.en: Why are drains not allowed in ISO 5 and ISO 7 cleanrooms? Why is ISO 8 an allowed exception?

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品從灌裝線轉移至凍乾機的過程中，若廠房設計未能維持Class 100，可能帶來哪些風險？FDA會如何看待這個缺口？
blocks.en: If facility design fails to maintain Class 100 during transfer of lyophilized product from the filling line to the lyophilizer, what risks could result? How would FDA view this gap?

blocks.zh: 一家CDMO考慮在新廠房中引入隔離器技術。從FDA合規和商業角度，各提出兩個支持和兩個反對的論點。
blocks.en: A CDMO is considering introducing isolator technology in a new facility. From the FDA compliance and commercial perspectives, give two arguments for and two against.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室空調非計畫停機後，在什麼條件下才能恢復生產？需要哪些書面記錄？
blocks.en: After an unplanned cleanroom HVAC shutdown, under what conditions can production resume? What written records are needed?

blocks.zh: Section IV Summary / 本節重點摘要
blocks.en: Section IV Summary

blocks.zh: 本節核心學習要點
blocks.en: Key Learning Points of This Section

blocks.zh: 五大核心概念回顧
blocks.en: Review of the Five Core Concepts

blocks.zh: 分級設計：四個等級（Class 100/1,000/10,000/100,000）形成污染防禦的「洋蔥層」結構
blocks.en: Classification design: the four classes (Class 100/1,000/10,000/100,000) form an "onion-layer" structure of contamination defense

blocks.zh: 壓差管理：10–15 Pa的壓差是合規的「最低生命線」，連續監測+完整記錄是查廠核心
blocks.en: Pressure differential management: a differential of 10-15 Pa is the compliance "lifeline"; continuous monitoring plus complete records are the core of an inspection

blocks.zh: HEPA完整性：效率測試≠洩漏測試；0.01%標準是「零容忍」的工程表達
blocks.en: HEPA integrity: efficiency test ≠ leak test; the 0.01% limit is the engineering expression of "zero tolerance"

blocks.zh: 人員最小化：每一次人員介入都是風險；自動化、SIP、隔離器是系統性解決方案
blocks.en: Minimizing personnel: every intervention is a risk; automation, SIP and isolators are the systematic solutions

blocks.zh: 書面程序：211.113(b)要求書面SOP，從清潔消毒到停機恢復都必須有文件化程序
blocks.en: Written procedures: 211.113(b) requires written SOPs, and everything from cleaning and disinfection to shutdown recovery must have a documented procedure

blocks.zh: FDA 483常見觀察項目（Section IV相關）
blocks.en: Common FDA 483 Observations (Section IV related)

blocks.zh: 壓差監測記錄不連續或警報未調查
blocks.en: Pressure differential monitoring records not continuous, or alarms not investigated

blocks.zh: HEPA洩漏測試頻率不足或方法不合規
blocks.en: HEPA leak testing frequency insufficient or method non-compliant

blocks.zh: Smoke Study在靜態而非動態條件下執行
blocks.en: Smoke study performed under static rather than dynamic conditions

blocks.zh: 潔淨室角落/表面不符合光滑易清潔要求
blocks.en: Cleanroom corners/surfaces not meeting smooth, easily cleanable requirements

blocks.zh: 停機後恢復生產無書面程序
blocks.en: No written procedure for resuming production after a shutdown

blocks.zh: 壓縮氣體過濾器未定期更換或進行完整性測試
blocks.en: Compressed gas filters not replaced periodically or integrity tested

blocks.zh: Section IV 綜合複習題
blocks.en: Section IV Comprehensive Review Questions

blocks.zh: 描述一個符合FDA要求的無菌填充廠房壓差梯度設計（從填充室到外部走廊）。
blocks.en: Describe a pressure cascade design for an aseptic filling facility that meets FDA expectations (from the filling room to the outside corridor).

blocks.zh: HEPA洩漏測試在哪些情況下需要「計畫外」執行？列出至少四種觸發條件。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances must HEPA leak testing be performed "unscheduled"? List at least four triggers.

blocks.zh: Table 1中「行動水準（Action Level）」與「規格限（Specification Limit）」有何本質差異？超過行動水準需要採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: What is the fundamental difference between an "Action Level" and a "Specification Limit" in Table 1? What steps are required when an action level is exceeded?

blocks.zh: 一家CDMO的Class 10,000填充室緊鄰Class 100的灌裝工作站。FDA對這個相鄰關係有什麼要求？
blocks.en: A CDMO's Class 10,000 room is immediately adjacent to a Class 100 filling workstation. What does FDA require of this adjacency?

blocks.zh: 請解釋為何「通過HEPA洩漏測試但氣流速度不均勻」的HEPA仍然需要更換或調整。
blocks.en: Explain why a HEPA filter that "passes the leak test but has non-uniform airflow velocity" still needs to be replaced or adjusted.
